purpose: Verify a compositional positive number/spin state and literal fermionic Hamiltonian action before larger accuracy work
source_of_physics: Own synthetic spin-independent one-/two-electron Hamiltonians; positive Coulomb pair matrices, fixed CUDA seed
independent_product_test: Eight separate 4-electron/3-orbital singlet mixed states, 32 electrons in 24 orbitals; additive supplied independent Hamiltonian, no global occupation enumeration
family_embedding_test: Three fragment purifications embedded in the same reduced CG tensor family, compared with direct concatenation
legacy_special_case: Ancilla dimension one must match the unchanged pure-state family after exact parameter copying
failure_policy: Record any failed operator, gradient or physical invariant before using this backend for chemistry; no energy-only acceptance
scope: New representation/operator tests, not a chemical-accuracy, WTMAD-2, learned-transfer or speed benchmark
resource_limit: One CUDA job, one host orchestration core; under 1 GB new disk and existing 40 GB total allocation
